name: Shima Aoi
source: A second-year at Mihashi High School and [url=/c43014]Kei's[/url] best friend. He is very popular with the girls at his school to the point where he even has his own fan club. However, he has a very blunt personality and sometimes even comes off as very sharp-tongued.
